text:
taylor: heads up — sample-app edge build is 500ing on import resolution when using rollup-prod.
jamie: any logs? which import style are you using (default vs namespace)?
taylor: `import Redwood from "redwood-js"` + we had a fallback `const cfg = require("./cfg")`. node build ok, edge fails: Cannot find module '/var/task/_static/cfg_index.js'
riley: dynamic require + rollup commonjs plugin often rewrites paths. try replacing require with `await import()` or make it a static ESM import.
taylor: switched to `await import('./cfg')` and edge resolves now, but typescript errors without `--esModuleInterop`.
jamie: hm we should document `esModuleInterop` implications for onboarding and update sample-app tsconfig to be compatible. also add a smoke test: vite+rollup builds for node/edge.
build-bot: created job devex/bundler-edge-smoke, will run nightly and on PRs.
taylor: created PR with import fixes + note in onboarding doc. ping me if you see similar failures and include `vite build --debug` or rollup stats.
